primary: PMID42456169 DOI10.1158/1535-7163.MCT-26-0096 Jinno2026 Preclinical Evaluation of Liposomal Eribulin (E7389-LF) in a Panel of Sarcoma Patient-Derived Xenograft Models
question: Does the actual primary/public supplement model roster authenticate native EMC and link every such donor/model/passage/treatment/control condition to an interpretable measured assay, rather than only a broad sarcoma panel label?
stage: Independent identity, omission, assay-unit and scientific-value source review only. No response values, drug-activity conclusions, RNA outcomes or sequence data.
source_choice: Lead and owner selected this exact new primary before methods/response outcomes. Reviewer only inspected raw-file names/hashes/top-level JSON keys before this freeze.
reuse_first: R3/R7/R9 native-versus-engineered/disputed model eligibility decisions and existing unchanged failures. This source is not inferred as a new EMC model from its title.
owned_new_retrieval: None planned. Reuse radiotherapy exact cached EPMC/OpenAlex/public access metadata and any allowed sanitized model/condition records. No duplicate GET, publisher-denial retry or credential/private access.
required_native_identity: Author patient-derived EMC diagnosis with model/specimen identifier and source-linked pathology/diagnostic molecular evidence where available; generic sarcoma/chondrosarcoma, similar labels or H-EMC-SS/MUG identity do not establish canonical native EMC.
required_all_conditions: Donor versus individual mice, technical measurements, passage and repeated model preparations
Histologic review/specimen origin and authenticity limits
Treatment line/prior patient exposure and model passage/host/purity context where available
Formulation/control, dose units, route, schedule, assay time and replicate/randomization source fields
Data availability and actual public model/assay crosswalk, not a repository zero-hit count
assay_interpretation: Published xenograft intervention measurements are preclinical model evidence, not patient efficacy or new donor validation. No pooling by sarcoma umbrella label.
prior_art_value: The paper itself reports liposomal-eribulin platform/activity results. Merely locating an EMC model or repeating reported efficacy is not a new scientific contribution. A meaningful unanswered within-source or independent contrast must be defined, reviewed and frozen before any numerical stage.
strongest_alternatives: Panel contains only other sarcoma histologies
Generic or disputed culture/model transferred to EMC
Repeated mice/passages counted as independent patients
Apparent drug contrast caused by different dose/route/exposure or model selection
Authors already answered the proposed response question
stop_no_go: Native EMC eligibility or complete condition linkage is unestablished
Primary or real supplement inaccessible through ordinary public routes
Only metadata title/abstract/paper landing page available
No consequential unreported contrast beyond authors published result
no_go_scope: Current source-specific pending eligibility/access/assay gap, never verified EMC absence or exhaustion of public PDX evidence. Suitable public evidence left unassessed blocks promotion.
constraints: No FAP-tissue, glycan, HLA or structural/fusion-formation analysis. Quiet file/API only, no UI/images, spend/outreach/publication/PR/shared mutation. Raw originals/cache-only, <=8MiB new, >=10GiBfree. Codex author and committer.
